difficulties: Ministry of Justice / HMPPS conditional-discharge report in three parts plus a patient annex, 12 pages. Part A is a 16-row label|answer grid spanning pages 2-3; the MDT-members answer cell already contains blue guidance prompts that must be handled (replaced or kept) rather than treated as an answer. Parts B and C are long question paragraphs each followed by an unlabelled single-cell box table (36 boxes in total), so the label for every box is the preceding paragraph and several boxes straddle page breaks; section headings (Supervision, Diagnosis) repeat across parts with different questions. The accommodation-type question is a bulleted list of 8 options with hollow "o" bullets and no checkbox, glyph or form field, so a selection has no native tick target, the options are not mutually exclusive (recorded as multi_choice), and "other (please specify)" relies on the following unlabelled box. Three sign-off tables repeat the labels Signature / Email address and Telephone number / Date of Report (social supervisor, line manager, clinical supervisor) and are disambiguated only by position. Answer areas belong to different authors (social supervisor, line manager, clinical supervisor, patient), and the annex boxes must contain the patient’s own words. No content controls, legacy fields, checkboxes or text boxes exist in the body; the header has only logos and the footer only a PAGE field and version text.
unsupportable: None strictly unsupportable. Caveats: the accommodation choice has no checkbox/tick target (selection must be expressed by marking the option paragraph text); signatures must be left for wet/e-signature; the patient annex answers (A59-A61) require the patient’s own input and should not be generated from a clinical encounter.

review_changes.why: kind choice -> multi_choice: the accommodation options are two bullet groups (numId 23 accommodation type; numId 24 own flat/house, with family, with partner, other) that are not mutually exclusive, e.g. 'own flat/house' + 'with partner' or 'Local Authority accommodation' + 'with family' can both hold, so a faithful fill must be allowed to mark more than one; notes updated accordingly
